title: Window previews appear at different speeds
line: Moving the pointer from one task manager icon to the next now always shows the next tooltip right away instead of sometimes waiting the full delay again.
explanation: The task manager's TriangleMouseFilter holds back the hover enter of the next icon for 300 ms when the pointer moves sideways near the top of the icons (it thinks the pointer may be heading for the tooltip). Meanwhile the old icon's hover leave dismisses the tooltip after 200 ms, so when the held enter finally arrives no tooltip is visible and ToolTipArea starts the full 700 ms show delay: about 1 s with no tooltip. Whether a move gets held depends on its path, hence the inconsistency. ToolTipDialog now remembers when its hide timer closed it, and ToolTipArea shows its tooltip immediately on hover enter if a tooltip was dismissed less than 500 ms ago.

commits.message:
declarativeimports/core: show tooltip at once if another just closed

Moving between task manager icons, the triangle filter can hold back the
next icon's hover enter until the old tooltip has closed, so the new one
waited the full delay. Now it shows at once if one closed under 500 ms.

BUG: 513390

media.caption: Master, 14 launchers: quick sweep from Info Center to System Monitor near the top of the icons. The old tooltip fades out and the new one appears only about 1 s after the pointer arrives.
With the fix, same sweep (also held by the filter): the old tooltip cross-fades into System Monitor's with no empty gap.
Frames every 100 ms, pointer reaches System Monitor at +300 ms: blank from +700 to +1200 ms, new tooltip at +1300 ms.
Same frames with the fix: new tooltip at +700 ms, overlapping the old one fading out, never blank.

review.text: The cause is in the TriangleMouseFilter (plasma-workspace components/trianglemousefilter): it holds back the next icon's HoverEnter but lets the old icon's HoverLeave through, so the old tooltip is dismissed before the held enter arrives. The libplasma change works around this with a global 500 ms 'recently dismissed' grace that changes tooltip timing everywhere, and it still leaves the filter's ~0.4 s hold.
changes: Fix it in TriangleMouseFilter / the task manager instead: while an enter is held, keep the old tooltip alive (hold the matching HoverLeave too, or keepalive the tooltip) so the new enter takes ToolTipArea's existing 'tooltip visible' fast path
Drop the libplasma recentlyDismissed change, or propose it separately as a deliberate QToolTip-like behaviour change
